what_backs_your_app.how: a script runs the command as an argument list with no shell

what_backs_your_app.use: repo-radar, around (several APIs joined); lookup-template, chart-template, table-template, portal-template (one API, config only)
what_backs_your_app.limits: declare network; a shell variable never reaches the script

what_backs_your_app.how: Bolt makes one GET or POST to 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1; no script
what_backs_your_app.limits: loopback only, one request, no secrets, no chaining

what_backs_your_app.how: a script reads a path the person types, with caps and a regular-file check
what_backs_your_app.limits: declare files; the path travels as query words, not in a nav arg

what_backs_your_app.how: a bridge script starts the MCP server over stdio and calls one tool (see ENGINE.md, MCP workaround)
what_backs_your_app.limits: tested only against a stand-in server; the person needs the server installed; 15 s cap; one tool per app
